Sandstorm

Released September 18, 2003 · 100 cards

Sandstorm is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on September 18, 2003. It has 100 cards. It includes 92 Pokémon, 7 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

15 illustrators worked on Sandstorm. Most cards: Mitsuhiro Arita (14), Midori Harada (13), Atsuko Nishida (11), Ken Sugimori (11), Hajime Kusajima (10), Kouki Saitou (9), Kagemaru Himeno (8), Ryo Ueda (7).
